notes: Source: official Lightware product brief PDF (archive.lightware.com), Part No. 9131 0050, confirmed against rear/front panel photos in the same document. Video: 8x HDMI 2.0 in / 8x HDMI 2.0 out, 18 Gbps per port, fully non-blocking, up to 4096x2160@60Hz RGB 4:4:4, HDCP 1.4/2.2, HDMI 1.x/2.0 and DVI 1.0 compliant. Audio: 8x stereo balanced analog audio embedder inputs and 8x de-embedded audio outputs, each on 5-pole Phoenix/euroblock connectors (only stereo LPCM can be de-embedded). Control: RS-232 on 3-pole Phoenix/euroblock, Ethernet RJ45, and a front-panel mini-USB (labeled 'USB CTRL') — mapped to 'usb-micro' since 'mini-usb' is not an available connector id in the schema; treat this as an approximation of the real mini-USB-B connector. Power: single IEC C14 inlet, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, max 75W, fused F3.15A. Rack: 1RU, 442mm W (482mm with ears) x 277.5mm D x 43.7mm H, 3.25kg. No DisplayPort, SDI, or digital audio (AES/TOSLINK) ports on this model — confirmed both by the brief's connector table and the comparison table on page 4 showing DP='x' for this SKU. HDMI grade set to hdmi-2.0 per manufacturer's explicit "HDMI 2.0" labeling and 18Gbps bandwidth (matches HDMI 2.0 spec ceiling); note the brief also states 1080p@120Hz and optional 4:4:4→4:2:0 subsampling / horizontal splitting to 2x HDMI1.4 links as advanced features, not separate physical ports. This is the "-Audio-L" variant (adds the 8x8 balanced analog audio embed/de-embed connectors and front-panel LCD/buttons) versus the plain "MX2-8x8-HDMI20-L" (no audio ports) and "MX2-8x8-HDMI20-CA" (only 2x audio ports, no front panel controls) — do not conflate specs across these sibling SKUs.
